en.title: Echo of Latency: Remnants of Memory and the Observer of the Lighthouse
en.premise: In a world where the "Memory Exchange"—a black market for digitizing and trading unwanted memories—runs rampant, a young man named Kai works as a memory courier. One day, he comes across corrupted data depicting an "old lighthouse" that shouldn't exist. Hidden within that data is a mysterious bug that begins to erode the boundaries of reality. Caught between the accelerating noise of the virtual world and the silence of real-world loneliness, Kai begins a search for the contours of his lost self.

zh.title: 延迟之回响 ―记忆的残滓与灯塔的观测者―
zh.premise: 在这个名为“记忆交易所”的黑市横行、人们将不需要的记忆数据化并进行买卖的世界里，青年凯是一名记忆搬运工。某日，他偶然拾到了一段记录着本不该存在的“古老灯塔”风景的缺失数据。然而，这段数据中潜藏着一个开始侵蚀现实世界边界的神秘Bug。在虚拟世界加速的噪点与现实世界静谧的孤独之间，凯开始寻找失落自我的轮廓。
